same_discrete.definition: Generated once by the same discrete lower-branch forward solver; code-consistency / inverse-crime control only.

continuous_definition: u_alpha(x)=-2 log(cosh(alpha*(x-.5))/cosh(alpha/2)); alpha=1.5; no inverse-grid forward solve used.
perturbation_definition: Fixed deterministic sensor perturbations, used without resampling; not a probability model.
